verdict.rationale: Gitea's marketing lists generic 'Audit Logs' and 'audit logging', and an official MCP server exists. However, no evidence shows that AI agent sessions or agent-initiated actions are recorded and attributed to the user who triggered them. Generic audit logging is an adjacent control and earns no credit for this agent-specific governance story.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can audit AI agent sessions and actions attributed to the user who triggered them
